summary: Reorganize the existing Owner PWA for iPad Mini use: truthful Cart/Internet/Matrix status, four quick controls, guest access and QR spacing, collapsed troubleshooting, and explicit unavailable guest status, while preserving current score, command, and default guest semantics.

scoped_evidence.approved_architecture_reference: Existing static Owner PWA, course-status implementation, command handlers, guest-default migration, and release control model; no runtime or architecture replacement.
scoped_evidence.affected_subsystem: Owner PWA first-screen layout, status wording, diagnostics disclosure, and guest QR layout. Score fetching, command paths, guest default-on policy, cloud writes, and release controls remain on existing code paths.
scoped_evidence.rollback_reference: Revert the source changes in hbnf-final-controller/hbnf-cart.html, hbnf-final-controller/hbnf-cart-ui-v6.css, hbnf-final-controller/hbnf-cart.js, and the focused test/change record. Preserve the original v1.0.10 package and do not install this source before refreshed release gates.
evidence_sources: Owner-provided Cart iPad screenshots IMG_3460.JPG and IMG_3461.JPG, 2026-10-22: technical diagnostics dominate the current page; QR lacks comfortable spacing; status overstates device confirmation.

tests: Focused iPad owner-home structural and touch-target regression test.
Existing Cart/WAN, score freshness, Matrix revision acknowledgment, and guest default/toggle/reload/link tests.
Existing Text and Show Scores acknowledgment/rejection/draft-preservation behavior tests.

owner_design_gate.selected_option: Use the existing HBNF green/night design system and an accessory-control home pattern: verified status and a small quick-control row first; guest state and share QR next; detailed controls below; transport/device diagnostics behind collapsed Troubleshooting. Preserve status uncertainty and all existing behavior.
